title: Change your administration password
purpose: Replace the signed-in administrator’s own password.
summary: Change your own password from administration.

tasks.title: Change your password
steps: Type the new one in [[New password]] and [[New password confirmation]].
Select [[Change my password]]. You stay signed in here.

tasks.title: Change another user's password
steps: Open the user under Users and use the password form on their account instead.

good_to_know: Other browsers signed in with the old password stop working.
There is no forgotten-password link here. Use the application's sign-in page for that.
Your roles, capabilities, client link and two-factor settings stay the same.
A new password needs at least 15 characters, or 8 if the laboratory requires a second sign-in factor of your account. The form states which.

sections.title: Access and fields
paragraphs: Requires an active staff account signed into administration. This is not the target-user password maintenance form.

items.label: Old password
items.description: Required existing password for the signed-in account.

items.label: New password
items.description: Required replacement. The help under it states the rule for your account: at least 15 characters, or 8 where the laboratory's second sign-in factor rule covers it, read again at the save. Common and expected passwords (a common password or a name of the laboratory, the application or the account with only digits, symbols, spaces or letter case changed, a repeat, a run) and ones too similar to your details are refused. No required kinds of character.

items.label: Change my password
items.description: Validates and saves, preserves this session’s authentication hash, and opens the password-changed acknowledgement. Other sessions using the old hash cease to authenticate.

items.label: Home
items.description: Returns to administration home without saving.

sections.title: Limits
paragraphs: No Forgot your password link appears on this stock form. No laboratory role, capability, client assignment or factor record is changed. This self-service page does not invoke the project’s audited administrator change-of-another-user password handler. Password fields may need re-entering after errors.
